lines.speaker: DEEP SPACE ARRAY
lines.text: A narrowband burst arrived at 03:11 UTC. It is not language. It is structured.

lines.speaker: DR. IMANE KESSLER
lines.text: No glyphs. No images. The envelope looks like a machine that expects to be exercised.

lines.speaker: DR. IMANE KESSLER
lines.text: If we can reconstruct the operation it encodes, we may have a first vocabulary.

lines.speaker: DR. IMANE KESSLER
lines.text: The artifact is stable only when both stimulus lines are asserted. Conjunction. Logical, or something that behaves like it.

lines.speaker: ARCHIVE
lines.text: Humanity now has one confirmed primitive. Interpretation remains contested.

lines.speaker: CRYOSLEEP PROTOCOL
lines.text: The next burst is not expected for years. You will sleep. Institutions will not.

lines.speaker: DEEP SPACE ARRAY
lines.text: A related fragment. Smaller. The return line disagrees with the stimulus.

lines.speaker: DR. IMANE KESSLER
lines.text: If the first artifact was conjunction, this may be inversion. Or it may only look that way.

lines.speaker: DR. IMANE KESSLER
lines.text: Negation. A complete Boolean basis is now in reach. That is a human conclusion. We still do not know if it is theirs.
